rows.grounds: bahuvrihi compound describing kaniṣṭhe; tips directed outward/upward
the two smallest fingers of the hands

items.question: What position must the little fingers assume in the described hand gesture?
premises: The little fingers are the subject of the instruction.
Their tips are described as extended.
They are directed and situated upward.
items.inference: The little fingers must be placed upward with their tips extended.
uncertainties: The exact degree of extension implied by prasakta is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And the little fingers, with their tips extended, are to be held upward.
